gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 1580.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. KH 3170 commencing at its junction with Tsz Wan Shan Road about 85 m north of the junction of Tsz Wan Shan Road and Yuk Wah Street running in a south-westerly direction for about 70 m, turning westward for about 190 m and then continuing in a north-westerly direction for about 35 m and terminating at its junction with Hong Wah Street. Proposed Name: YAN WAH STREET. Chinese Version: 欣華街.
